description: The bar chart illustrates the effect of varying diffusion steps (100, 250, 500, 1000, and 2000) on text generation quality, as measured by three ROUGE metrics — ROUGE-1 (blue with diagonal stripes), ROUGE-2 (light green with dots), and ROUGE-L (orange with horizontal stripes) — on the XSum dataset, using the optimal value from 5 Gaussian samples. The horizontal axis represents the number of diffusion steps, while the vertical axis indicates the ROUGE score values, ranging from 0 to approximately 42. At 100 steps, ROUGE-1 is 6.3, ROUGE-2 is 0.1, and ROUGE-L is 3.0. At 250 steps, ROUGE-1 rises to 11.6, ROUGE-2 to 0.4, and ROUGE-L to 8.3. At 500 steps, ROUGE-1 reaches 21.1, ROUGE-2 is 4.1, and ROUGE-L is 15.9. At 1000 steps, ROUGE-1 peaks at 38.3, ROUGE-2 at 16.5, and ROUGE-L at 30.7. At 2000 steps, ROUGE-1 slightly increases to 41.2, ROUGE-2 to 19.1, and ROUGE-L to 33.4. Across all diffusion steps, ROUGE-1 consistently shows the highest scores, followed by ROUGE-L, and then ROUGE-2, with all metrics increasing as the number of diffusion steps increases, suggesting improved text generation quality with more steps.
